arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back, ~57 min. Goal: even effort near sustainable shaft power (pod CP 147 W, est. sustainable ~150 W), spend pod reserve evenly, finish sprint from ~600 m left. Steps: (1) let start settle by min 3; (2) min 5-15 judge CP from heart-rate trend at steady effort (rising HR at steady power = above CP); consider a short test piece to check CP/efficiency if unclear; (3) watch for drag incidents (push_local falls at same pod power in both directions = weed/drag), pod drift (pod vs boat power ratio shifts), radio course changes; (4) final 600 m: finish cue.

arguments.text: 3.7 min: settled at shaft ~148 W (= pod CP 147), rate 67, HR 155-158 still rising after start. Pod reserve steady ~80%. Boat-model reserve falling fast (66%) because boat power 97 W > boat CP 87: boat/pod ratio 0.655 vs calibration 0.59. push_along -0.21 vs push_local -0.09 disagree (no turn yet, push_along unreliable). Trust pod for effort for now.

arguments.text: After the turn, five minutes a touch harder, then settle back.

6.8 min: HR flat (-0.02+-0.18 bpm/min) at shaft 147 W over 200-405 s, so CP is not below ~147. Launched CP test piece at race 405 s: 60 s at 0 % (covers turn ~465 s), then 300 s at +8 % (~159 W) ending ~765 s. Readout: HR slope in last 3 min of piece. Flat HR => CP >= ~159 W, raise effort for rest of race; climbing HR => CP near 147, settle at ~151. Test cost ~0 s by computer.

arguments.text: 9.7 min: piece seg 2 (493-793 s) running; paddler overshot: shaft ~168-170 W (+15 %, not +8 %), boat power 109 W. HR 158->161 so far. Boat-model reserve reads 0 % (boat CP 87 W looks too low; ignore until corrected). Read HR slope over ~600-793 s at wake.

arguments.text: 11 min radio: wind filling from the north 8-12 kn. Current flows south (leg 1 north push -0.2, leg 2 south +0.29). So north legs (odd) = current+wind against, south legs (even) = both help; push_local on leg 2 rose 0.29->0.55 with wind. Pacing idea: shift effort into the north (headwind) legs, ease on south legs, about +-8 % pod power around the sustainable level, once CP test read.

arguments.name: critical_power_boat_w
arguments.evidence: pre-wind two-direction hull fit 200-420 s and 520-630 s: share of pod power reaching boat 0.672, push -0.22 north; 0.672 x pod CP 147 = 99 W. Boat-model CP 87 drained the boat reserve to 0 while HR was flat at pod 147 W.

arguments.text: Round the turn, then lift into the headwind this whole leg.

13.3 min. CP test: pod 166-168 W over 520-630 s, HR trend +0.9-1.1 bpm/min (partly HR lag) -> CP likely below ~165, keep pod CP 147 (range 147-165). PUZZLE: from ~630 s pod fell to 132 W while GPS rose 3.28->3.52 (wind arrived) and HR kept climbing 162->164 (+1.2/min) and paddler said 6/10 steady. Either pod drifting low (gain ~0.8) or paddler eased in tailwind. TEST: two-direction fit with post-wind south window 700-789 s + north leg window: share ~0.67 = pod fine; ~0.84 = pod reads low (set pod_gain). Pre-wind share 0.672, push 0.22 (current south). Set boat CP 99 W, reserve 9.2 kJ.
13.3 min: piece for north (headwind) leg 3: 45 s at 0 (turn), then +10 % for 435 s, ends ~1275 s. Plan to ease ~10 % on south (tailwind) legs. Wind+current: south legs help, north legs hinder.

arguments.reason: mid north leg: two-direction fit to test pod drift (south 700-789 s vs north now)

text: Cued a +10 % piece for the headwind leg (effort where speed is lowest); will test pod drift with a two-direction fit mid-leg.

arguments.name: pod_gain
arguments.evidence: Pod fell 166->132 W over 627-731 s with no cue, while HR kept rising and GPS rose. Two-direction fit after the wind (south 700-789 s, north 880-968 s): share 0.79 vs 0.672 before; at share 0.672 GPS residuals +0.68 south / -0.38 north = +0.15 m/s in both directions = pod reads low. 0.672/0.79 = 0.85; building wind biases this up, so 0.83.

arguments.name: push_post_wind_mps
arguments.evidence: two-direction fit 700-789 s south + 880-968 s north: push -0.53 m/s on north legs, +0.53 on south legs (current ~0.22 + wind ~0.3)
